content:
I can understand and generate text in a wide range of languages, although my proficiency and capabilities are best in English. Here are some of the languages I can work with, to varying degrees:

1. English - Proficient in reading, writing, and understanding.
2. Spanish, French, German, Italian, Dutch, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Japanese - Capable of reading, writing, and understanding basic to intermediate levels.
3. Other languages - I can process and generate text in many other languages, but my proficiency may be more limited.

Here's a rough list of some other languages I can work with, to varying degrees:

Afrikaans, Arabic, Bengali, Bulgarian, Catalan, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Finnish, Greek, Gujarati, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Irish, Javanese, Kannada, Korean, Latin, Malay, Malayalam, Marathi, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Serbian, Slovak, Swahili, Swedish, Tamil, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, Vietnamese, and Welsh.

While I can process and generate text in these languages, my performance may not be as good as in English, and my knowledge cutoff is 2021, so I might not understand recent developments or neologisms in these languages. Additionally, I don't translate word for word, but rather, I understand the meaning and generate a response in the target language.
